author: RandomTrollface
body: The other classes need gear to work well, but when they have that gear they generally work better than GS which cannot really scale. A heretic or deity with ara vesta 2 or a gilga with chained shield will be a lot faster than GS for clearing towers. GS will have an advantage if you're beginner but it will fall off once you get better gear for the other classes. GS power doesn't really scale because summon stat augments are additive, for instance a 12% summon stat augment amounts to 3.6% ish percent more relative stats which diminishes even more the more you spec into it, meanwhile the other classes get stuff like 40% crit amities and free deific channel from phoenix which have a much larger effect.
